# Crosslake Cabin

> A log cabin vacation rental in the pines on Big Trout Lake (Whitefish Chain of Lakes), Manhattan Point, Crosslake, Minnesota 56442. Hosted by Chad and Barb. Book on Airbnb or Vrbo.

- Location: Manhattan Point on Big Trout Lake, 3 miles from downtown Crosslake, MN; about two and a half hours north of Minneapolis-St. Paul.
- Sleeps up to 6: private upstairs bedroom with a queen bed; semi-private loft with two built-in bunks; a pull-out for two more; one full bathroom on the main level. No pets.
- Features: open floorplan, stacked-stone gas fireplace, air conditioning, washer and dryer, full kitchen with a four-stool dining bar, free WiFi, two HD smart TVs. On the water: the cabin's own dock, a hill lift down to the shore and a lakeside fire pit.
- Seasons: fall color and fireplace evenings; winter ice fishing, snowmobiling and cross-country skiing in the Brainerd Lakes area; spring open water and the Minnesota fishing opener in May.
- Nearby: 4-mile paved walking and biking loop around Manhattan Point; restaurants include The Wharf, Moonlite Bay, Riverside Tavern, Maucieri's Italian Bistro, Norway Ridge supper club and Crosslake Coffee.
- Stay rules: check-in after 12:00 PM, check-out by 10:00 AM, two-night minimum.
- Book: direct at https://crosslakecabin.com/#book, or on Airbnb https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1566827553369631773 or Vrbo https://www.vrbo.com/4979138
- Questions: email Chad at chad.anderson.cirriussolutions@gmail.com.
